content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a static site hosting service that allows you to publish web pages directly from a GitHub repository. For digital creators, this means you can host an online store at no cost. Unlike traditional platforms that charge high fees, such as Gumroad's 10% on sales, using GitHub Pages with a proper backend setup allows you to reduce transaction fees to just 0.5% with NOWPayments. This infrastructure not only saves creators money but also empowers them with complete ownership of their content and customer data.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a GitHub Pages-based digital product store includes several key components working together seamlessly. You host your site on GitHub Pages, using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle backend logic. NOWPayments processes cryptocurrency transactions, providing a direct payment solution without requiring buyers to create accounts. This setup allows for automated product delivery once payments are confirmed, ensuring a smooth experience for both creators and customers. The integration of these technologies eliminates reliance on third-party platforms, granting creators greater control over their sales process.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This setup is specifically designed for digital creators in countries where traditional payment processors are unavailable or heavily restricted. If you're selling ebooks, courses, or templates in regions like Ghana, Cameroon, or Zimbabwe, this solution offers a straightforward way to monetize your work without incurring prohibitive fees. By leveraging GitHub Pages and NOWPayments, creators can establish a professional online presence and cater to a global audience, all while retaining ownership and control over their transactions.
Save money on fees with NOWPayments — just 0.5%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The primary components of this infrastructure include GitHub Pages for hosting your website, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend processing, and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payment handling. Using these tools, you can set up a fully operational digital store that automatically delivers products upon payment confirmation. Additionally, integrating a cloud storage solution like Google Drive ensures that your digital files are easily accessible to your customers. Each component is essential for creating a streamlined experience that maximizes efficiency and minimizes costs.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your digital product store, start by creating a GitHub repository and setting up your site on GitHub Pages. Next, configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage your backend logic. After that, integrate NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions. Finally, upload your digital products to Google Drive and link them to your site. Once everything is set up, you can start selling your products instantly, with full ownership and minimal fees.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using GitHub Pages for hosting and integrating NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. This setup allows you to keep 99.5% of your sales revenue, significantly more than platforms like Gumroad that take a 10% fee, making it a viable solution for digital creators seeking independence.
Retain complete ownership of your digital products and customer data.

For those interested in building a comprehensive digital commerce stack, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). It includes all 6 blueprints and all 7 templates you need to deploy and scale your digital store effectively. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more details.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip by setting up a digital store using GitHub Pages and integrating payment processing through NOWPayments. This approach gives you full control and ownership of your sales.
Is it difficult to set up a digital product store on GitHub Pages?

Setting up a digital product store on GitHub Pages is straightforward. You create a GitHub repository, configure GitHub Pages, set up your backend, and integrate payment processing. There are numerous resources to guide you through each step.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept with NOWPayments?

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept a wide variety of digital currencies as payment. This flexibility ensures that you can cater to a global audience without relying on traditional payment processors.
